# docker_container_changes (Data Source)

Lists the filesystem changes of a container against its image, like `docker container diff`. Each entry of `changes` has a `path` and a `kind`: 0 modified, 1 added, 2 deleted.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "docker_container_changes" "web" {
  container = "web"
}

# Paths the container added (kind 1) on top of its image.
output "added_paths" {
  value = [for c in data.docker_container_changes.web.changes : c.path if c.kind == 1]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `container` (String) The container to read, by ID or name.

### Read-Only

- `changes` (Attributes List) The GET /containers/{id}/changes response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--changes))
- `changes_json` (String) The Engine API GET /containers/{id}/changes response as JSON; entries sorted by Path. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).
- `container_id` (String) ID of the container the changes were read from.
- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of changes_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).

<a id="nestedatt--changes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `changes`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (Number) Upstream `Kind`.
- `path` (String) Upstream `Path`.
